messages:
Sam Chen: Uploaded a refreshed launch post draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-new-example. Need quick legal + product + eng checks. Goal: publish Wed 09:00 PT. Main items: hero benchmark copy, CTO quote, and webinar CTAs + HubSpot routing.
Lia Torres: Skimming. Recommend moving benchmark highlights above the narrative — people want numbers up front.
Oliver Park: Bench numbers look plausible but we need to state the baseline. Saying '60% cheaper' is vague. Can we be explicit: compared to an unoptimized 7B endpoint on p3?
Sam Chen: Good point. Raj, can you confirm baseline and a one-line hero stat we can cite?
Raj Patel: Confirmed runs: model-x-8q, batch=8, quant=4-bit. p50 ~85 ms for 8k context on Dedicated, token cost ~0.7¢/k with Optimize profile + prefix caching. I'll add measurement summary and the exact CLI commands to the sheet. Hero suggestion: ~85 ms p50 latency, ~0.7¢/k token cost (measurement attached).
Nina Gomez: Webinar CTA plan: primary = Register for live; secondary = Download the benchmarks PDF. HubSpot tags: launch-live, bench-pdf. Sales wants a 2-sentence blurb for outreach.
Sam Chen: Drafted a simple routing hook for ops: route=/thanks; tags=launch-live,bench-pdf; notify=webinar@redwood.com. Ops please sanity-check.
Lia Torres: Routing looks good. Ops to confirm the webhook email. Also legal asked to swap 'Massive cost savings' -> 'Significant cost savings'.
legal-bot: Automated check: any explicit cost or latency claims must include an attached measurement source and a short measurement summary. See policy at /policies/marketing-claims. Please attach raw eval logs or a spreadsheet.
Raj Patel: Uploaded raw eval logs and the measurement spreadsheet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/benchmark-uploads. The sheet includes commands, seeds, and config. I also scrubbed screenshots for PII.
Oliver Park: CTO quote? If Aisha or Marcus can't supply something by EOD, we should remove the placeholder. Ask for a 15-20 word line about reliability + determinism.
Sam Chen: Pinged @Aisha and @Marcus. Also requested product acceptance note.
Nina Gomez: I'll draft registration page copy today and gate the PDF behind an email capture with the bench-pdf tag so Sales gets routed leads.
Lia Torres: Approvals timeline: legal quick-pass by tomorrow noon, product sign-off by EOD tomorrow. If green, ops schedules publish and webinar invites.
legal-bot: Replacement of 'massive' with 'significant' suggested and flagged for human review.
Raj Patel: Uploaded sanitized screenshots to /assets/screens, see doc appendix. Also added a short appendix describing measurement methodology.
Sam Chen: Outstanding asks: Lia to write the Sales 2-sentence blurb; Nina to finalize webinar registration copy; Raj to attach measurement summary in the doc; legal to confirm final wording. Can someone book a 30m sync 11:30 PT?
Lia Torres: Booked 11:30-12:00 PT and sent invite.
Nina Gomez: :thumbsup: I'll route the registration page to growth-ops and share the HubSpot flow.
Sam Chen: Moving doc to 'final review' section. Will update this thread once legal gives the green light.
